reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded
  SELECT subscription_id,
    CAST(paid_at AS DATE) - CAST(LAG(paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY paid_at) AS DATE) AS gap_days
  FROM payments
  WHERE NOT refunded
)
SELECT s.plan_name, MAX(g.gap_days) AS max_gap_days
FROM gaps g
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = g.subscription_id
WHERE g.gap_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.plan_name

WITH kept AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded
  SELECT subscription_id, paid_at
  FROM payments
  WHERE NOT refunded
), gaps AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded
  SELECT k.subscription_id,
    CAST(k.paid_at AS DATE) - CAST((SELECT MAX(k2.paid_at) FROM kept k2 WHERE k2.subscription_id = k.subscription_id AND k2.paid_at < k.paid_at) AS DATE) AS gap_days
  FROM kept k
)
SELECT s.plan_name, MAX(g.gap_days) AS max_gap_days
FROM gaps g
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = g.subscription_id
WHERE g.gap_days IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.plan_name

WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per payment that was not refunded
  SELECT p.subscription_id, s.plan_name,
    CAST(p.paid_at AS DATE) - CAST(LAG(p.paid_at) OVER (PARTITION BY p.subscription_id ORDER BY p.paid_at) AS DATE) AS gap_days
  FROM payments p
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
)
SELECT plan_name, MAX(gap_days) AS max_gap_days
FROM gaps
GROUP BY plan_name
HAVING MAX(gap_days) IS NOT NULL

solver.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT s.plan_name, p.subscription_id, p.payment_id, p.paid_at, CAST(timezone('UTC', p.paid_at) AS DATE) AS d
  FROM payments p JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = p.subscription_id
  WHERE NOT p.refunded
), g AS (
  SELECT plan_name,
    d - LAG(d) OVER (PARTITION BY subscription_id ORDER BY paid_at, payment_id) AS gap
  FROM p
)
SELECT plan_name, MAX(gap) AS max_gap_days
FROM g
WHERE gap IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY plan_name
